question: Which are the top 10 sellers by total item price from delivered orders?
expected_sql: SELECT oi.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS total_item_price FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY total_item_price DESC LIMIT 10;

question: How many customers placed more than one order?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_multiple_orders FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(order_id) > 1);

question: How many orders had a total payment value greater than 500?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_above_500 FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment_value FROM payments GROUP BY order_id HAVING SUM(payment_value) > 500);

question: How many orders used more than one payment transaction?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_multiple_payment_transactions FROM (SELECT order_id FROM payments GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(payment_sequential) > 1);

question: Which order status has the highest average review score?
expected_sql: SELECT o.order_status, AVG(r.review_score) AS average_review_score FROM orders o JOIN reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY o.order_status ORDER BY average_review_score DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What was the total item price for each month of 2018, ordered chronologically?
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, SUM(oi.price) AS total_item_price FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

question: Which five customer states have the highest average payment value?
expected_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(p.payment_value) AS average_payment_value FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY average_payment_value DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which five product categories generated the most total item price while having at least 100 order items?
expected_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, SUM(oi.price) AS total_item_price, COUNT(*) AS order_item_count FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY total_item_price DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which sellers have generated more than 10,000 in total item price and have at least 50 order items?
expected_sql: SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS total_item_price, COUNT(*) AS order_item_count FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id HAVING SUM(price) > 10000 AND COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY total_item_price DESC;

question: For each customer state, what is the total number of orders and the total payment value, ordered by total payment value?
expected_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_payment_value FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY total_payment_value DESC;
